title: Ijaarsitoota Masaraa
intro: Yeroo dheeraa darbe keessatti qaroominni cimaan tokko ka’ee, hojii ijaarsaa dinqisiisaa fi humna sodaachisaa ta’een adda ture. Qaamni waloo kun qabeenya baay’ee fi dandeettii qaamaa kan kennameef ta’us, ergaa waaqummaa isaan qajeelchuuf ergame mormuuf daandii filataniiru. Seenaan isaanii seenaa seenaa keessatti barumsa gadi fagoo ta’ee tajaajila, bu’aa dhugaa diduun fiduuf ragaadha.
clues: Namoota bara keenyaa kaan irraa adda taʼee, humna qaamaa fi dheerinni guddaan nuuf kennameera.
Bakka olkaʼaa hundatti bara baraan jiraanna jennee yaaduudhaan caasaa gurguddaa fi utubaawwan olkaʼoo ijaaruudhaan beekamna turre.
Ergamaan nu keessaa nu akeekkachiisuuf ergame, akka Rabbiin tokkicha gabbaruu fi sanyiiwwan keenya dhiisnu nu waame.
Nutis Rabbiin gabbaruu fi waan abbootiin keenya gabbaran akka dhiifnuuf qofa nutti dhufanii jennee of tuulummaadhaan ergamaa keenya gaafanne.
Lafti keenya iddoo biqiltuu, burqaa fi maasii lalisaa ta’een kan eebbifamte ta’us, badhaadhina keenya garuu Uumaa keenyaaf utuu hin ta’in humna mataa keenyaaf kan maddan ta’e.
Kufrii fi qoosaa itti fufiinsa qabuuf, dhumarratti qilleensa sodaachisaa fi aarii guddaa qabuu fi halkanii fi halkan hedduu boba’een nu balleessine.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
